# Friday long runs against other seasons as the slope for Sunday

56 races at 24 circuits, 2023-2025 (14 sprint weekends, where the only practice session is used). Within-stint R² on the same race laps for each predictor.

| predictor | median R² | races above 0.2 |
|---|---|---|
| other seasons (Result 1) | 0.021 | 13 |
| Friday long runs | -0.502 | 6 |
| Friday, less its usual gap to Sunday | -0.339 | 3 |
| average of other seasons and corrected Friday | -0.054 | 9 |

Friday long runs degrade faster than the same compound in the race: the median gap is +0.059 s per lap. The corrected row subtracts that gap, learned on every other circuit so the held-out race never informs its own correction.

Friday minus other seasons: median -0.541, 95% interval resampling circuits [-1.127, -0.236]; better in 12 races, worse in 44 (sign test p = 0.000).

Corrected Friday minus other seasons: median -0.400 [-0.691, -0.124]; better in 11, worse in 45 (p = 0.000).

Both minus other seasons: median -0.051 [-0.119, -0.022]; better in 17, worse in 39 (p = 0.005).
